 MIZORAM BOARD DATE SHEET 2027 OUT 
 Mizoram Board Date Sheet 2027 Released: Check HSLC and HSSLC Class 10, 12 Exam Dates
 Mizoram Board of School Education (MBSE) has released the Mizoram Board Date Sheet 2027 for HSLC Class 10 and HSSLC Class 12 examinations. The Class 10 examinations will be conducted from February 10 to March 4, 2027, while Class 12 exams are scheduled from February 8 to March 15, 2027. Lavkesh Singh 12 Nov, 2026 Share

 Mizoram Board Exam Date Sheet 2027: Mizoram Board of School Education (MBSE) has released the Mizoram Board Date Sheet 2027 for Class 10 (HSLC) and Class 12 (HSSLC) examinations. The examination routines were issued on November 9, 2026, and published on the Board's official website, mbse.edu.in.
 According to the announced schedule, the HSSLC Class 12 examinations will begin on February 8 and continue until March 15, 2027. Meanwhile, the HSLC Class 10 examinations are scheduled from February 10 to March 4, 2027.
 The theory examinations for both classes will generally take place between 10 AM and 1 PM. MBSE has also announced the practical examination schedule, with Class 10 practicals beginning on February 4 and Class 12 practicals scheduled from February 1, 2027, onwards for the specified subjects.
 Students appearing for the board examinations should check the subject-wise timetable carefully and plan their revision accordingly. They can download the official date sheet PDFs from the MBSE website.
 For updates on other state and national board examinations, students can also check the Board Exam Dates 2027 page.

 Mizoram Board Practical Exam Dates 2027
 Along with the theory examination routine, MBSE has also announced the practical examination schedule for HSLC and HSSLC students.
 The practical examinations will be conducted between 9 AM and 4 PM.
 For Class 10 students, practical examinations in Home Science are scheduled for February 4, 2027. Science and Introductory Information Technology practical examinations will also begin on February 4 and continue as required.
 For Class 12 students, practical examinations in Geography, Psychology, Home Science and Geology are scheduled for February 1, 2027. Physics, Chemistry, Biology and Computer Science practical examinations will also begin on February 1 and continue onwards.
 Students should contact their respective schools for additional instructions regarding practical examinations, laboratory assessments and viva voce.
 How to Download Mizoram Board Date Sheet 2027?
 Students can download the MBSE HSLC and HSSLC Date Sheet 2027 from the official website. The timetable is available in PDF format and can be saved for future reference.
 Follow the steps below to download the examination routine:
 Visit the official Mizoram Board website at mbse.edu.in.
 Open the Notifications section on the homepage.
 Look for the 2027 HSLC Examination Routine or 2027 HSSLC Examination Routine.
 Select the relevant date sheet for Class 10 or Class 12.
 Click on the PDF link to open the timetable.
 Check the subject-wise examination dates and timings.
 Download the PDF and save a copy for future reference.
 Students can also access the official MBSE Notifications page to find the latest examination routines and announcements.
 Preparation Tips for MBSE HSLC and HSSLC Exams 2027
 With the Mizoram Board examinations scheduled to begin in February 2027, students should use the remaining preparation time effectively. A structured study routine can help candidates complete the syllabus and revise important topics before the examinations.
 Here are some useful preparation tips for Class 10 and Class 12 students:
 Prepare a subject-wise timetable: Divide the available study time between different subjects and prioritise topics that require additional revision.
 Practise previous years' question papers: Solving past examination papers can help students understand the question pattern and improve time management.
 Complete practical records: Class 10 and Class 12 students should finish their practical files, experiments and viva preparation before the practical examinations.
 Revise important concepts: Make short notes of important formulas, definitions and topics for quick revision.
 Attempt sample papers: Practise sample papers under examination-like conditions to improve speed and accuracy.
 Follow official instructions: Read the guidelines issued by MBSE regarding examination centres, admit cards and permitted materials.

 Students should also remember that any change in the announced examination schedule will be communicated through an official Board notification. They should follow the published timetable unless MBSE announces a revision.
 For the latest updates regarding the Mizoram Board examinations, admit cards and other announcements, students should regularly visit the official website, mbse.edu.in, and the PW Latest Education News section .
